description: This script contains tests and setup code for a system that incorporates Git and Perforce (P4), focusing on cloning repositories, handling large files through Mock LFS, and verifying file storage and behavior under various configurations.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Checks that a specified file is not stored in Mock LFS, verifying its content and existence.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a file and its associated LFS storage files exist and contain expected content, indicating storage in Mock LFS.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Ensures that a file has been deleted from the main directory while its LFS storage remains intact with expected content.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts and verifies the number of files in a directory, matching an expected count.
